description: Find cards in the catalogue of every paper printing — NOT limited to what the user owns (search_collection is that). query is the start of a name ("lightn"), any words of a name in any order ("bolt", "harvest hand"), or a set code and collector number ("FDN 120") for one exact printing (match "printing"; otherwise match "name" and scryfall_id is the printing a bare name means). A name in another language is found too, by its start or in full, and by any word for languages written with spaces: the hit is the card under its English name, with `matched` the name that found it ("Foudre" → Lightning Bolt): tell the user which card it is. Each hit carries owned (real copies of any printing), free (real copies no deck claims exclusively) and proxies. DISCLOSURE: proxies are never counted as owned — say "you hold N proxies" separately. Served from the local catalogue with no Scryfall call; a card released after the last catalogue load may be missing — card_detail by name still finds it once the user is signed in (before sign-in it reads the same catalogue, so ask them to sign in first). A very common word alone ("dragon", "of") reads only the first few hundred names: add another word or the start of the name. Default 12 hits, max 30. Before the user signs in, hits carry no owned, free or proxies: say nothing about what they own.

query.description: Name start, name words (in English or another language), or "SET NUMBER"

name: search_cards

hits.description: Catalogue hits, best first, not limited to what the user owns

free.description: Of the real copies, those no deck claims exclusively. Absent before sign-in

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

match.description: printing: the query named this exact printing; name: any printing of the card

matched.description: The name in another language that found the card: tell the user which card it is

owned.description: Real copies held, any printing. Proxies are never counted here. Absent before sign-in: never say the user owns none

proxies.description: Proxy copies held, counted apart from owned: say "you hold N proxies" separately. Absent before sign-in

scryfall_id.description: The printing a bare name means, or the exact printing for a set + number query

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

title: Search cards
